hook_text: A hippo would not last a day in the desert, and a meerkat would drown in a river. Every animal has its own address.
clip_script: A classroom mural in Bloemfontein. Four habitats, four addresses. Grassland: wide open grass, few trees. Zebra, blesbok, a secretary bird stamping on a snake. Forest: tall trees, cool shade. A green turaco flashes red in the Knysna canopy. River: fresh flowing water. Frogs, reeds and a hippo yawning. Sea: salty and huge. Dolphins chasing the sardine run. A habitat is where you live and get what you need. What is your habitat?
visual_style: Whiteboard map of South Africa with four zones lighting up in turn: grassland, forest, river and sea, each filling with its animals.
mood: Like a road trip across the country, with a new surprise at every stop.
pacing: Define habitat quickly, then four fast stops, each with three animals and one plant.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and name the habitat closest to your home.
